messages:
Jules: hi everyone, Jules here (platform). Just finished sign-up but when I run `kubectl get ns` I get `Forbidden` for several namespaces, including `dev` and `staging`. Who do I ask for kubeconfig/roles?
Marta (eng-infra): welcome Jules :wave: we handle onboarding. Can you paste `kubectl config current-context` and `kubectl auth can-i list namespaces`? Also what's your SSO name?
Jules: current-context is `rwd-dev-us-east-1`, `kubectl auth can-i list namespaces` -> no, SSO is jules.h@redwood.com, groups show `eng-infra-read` only.
infra-bot: ticket INFRA-2552 created for jules.h assigned to Marta. ETA ~30m.
Marta (eng-infra): thanks. Looks like your SSO group is read-only right now. Two quick paths: (A) add you to `engineering` group so you inherit RoleBindings in `dev`+`staging` or (B) create a short-lived namespace-scoped serviceaccount for immediate access. Which do you want?
Jules: I'll take the quick route (B) for now so I can follow onboarding docs.
Marta (eng-infra): OK creating svcacct. Run this to fetch a token (we scoped it to `dev` with `get,list,watch`):
```bash
kubectl -n dev create serviceaccount jules-onboard || true
TOKEN=$(kubectl -n dev create token jules-onboard --duration=12h)
kubectl config set-credentials jules-onboard --token="$TOKEN"
kubectl config set-context jules-dev --cluster=rwd-dev-cluster --namespace=dev --user=jules-onboard
kubectl config use-context jules-dev
```
Note: the `create serviceaccount` may already exist; we added `|| true` so it won't error locally.
Jules: ran it and `kubectl get pods -n dev` works now, thank you! One question: how do I avoid accidentally running `kubectl delete` in prod if my kubeconfig has multiple contexts?
Connor: rename prod contexts with a big prefix and set a shell prompt plugin. We also have a git repo `infra/tools/kube-helpers` with a `protect-prod` wrapper that refuses destructive commands if context matches `rwd-prod` (ping Marta for access).
Devon: small FYI: if you use the AWS SSO flow, tokens expire and you'll see Forbidden — looks like some folks confuse that with RBAC. On macOS, `aws-sso login` then re-run your command.
Marta (eng-infra): I've also updated your SSO group in the directory service so after you log out/in you'll get `engineering` membership and should keep access without the serviceaccount. I'll leave the token active for 12h as requested.
Jules: great, I see the group change reflected and `kubectl config use-context rwd-dev-us-east-1` still forbids listing namespaces (expected) but dev/staging access via the `jules-onboard` context works. Thanks for the quick help and the warm welcome! :smile:
Marta (eng-infra): welcome aboard Jules. If anything else blocks you ping #eng-infra or DM me.
